description: Korean Cream Cheese Garlic Bread is a popular street food known for its irresistible combination of savory garlic butter and sweet, tangy cream cheese filling. This recipe guides you through creating the perfect balance of crispy exterior and soft, flavorful interior. It is a truly delightful treat that captures the essence of Korean baking innovation.

ingredients.item: Round bread buns (like brioche or milk buns)
ingredients.notes: cut into 6 wedges, not all the way through

instructions.title: Prepare the Bread Buns
instructions.text: Preheat your oven to 160°C (325°F). Take each round bread bun and make 6 deep cuts, radiating from the center, but do not cut all the way through the bottom. The cuts should create wedges that can be pulled apart slightly.

instructions.title: Make the Cream Cheese Filling
instructions.text: In a medium bowl, combine the softened cream cheese, granulated sugar, and 2 tablespoons of heavy cream or milk. Mix well with a whisk or spatula until the mixture is smooth and creamy. Transfer this filling into a piping bag for easier application.

instructions.title: Fill the Bread Buns
instructions.text: Carefully open the cuts in each bread bun and pipe the cream cheese filling generously into each crevice. Ensure an even distribution of the filling throughout the bread. You can also spoon it in if you do not have a piping bag.

instructions.title: Prepare the Garlic Butter Dip
instructions.text: In another bowl, whisk together the melted unsalted butter, minced garlic, mayonnaise, egg, and honey or maple syrup until thoroughly combined. This mixture will be your savory and aromatic coating.

instructions.title: Dip and Bake
instructions.text: Carefully dip each cream cheese-filled bread bun into the garlic butter mixture, ensuring all sides and crevices are well coated. Place the dipped buns on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Sprinkle with dried parsley flakes.

instructions.title: Bake to Golden Perfection
instructions.text: Bake in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes, or until the bread is golden brown and the cream cheese filling is warm and slightly gooey. Keep an eye on it to prevent burning the garlic. Serve immediately while warm.

tips: For extra richness, use brioche buns. For a lighter texture, milk buns work perfectly. Ensure buns are fresh for the best result.
Make sure your cream cheese is at room temperature for a smooth, lump-free filling. Adjust sugar in the filling to your preferred sweetness.
Serve the garlic bread immediately after baking for the ultimate experience, when the bread is warm, crispy, and the filling is soft and creamy.
article:
The culinary world is constantly buzzing with new trends, and one that has captured hearts and palates globally is the irresistible Korean Cream Cheese Garlic Bread. This isn't just any garlic bread; it's a symphony of textures and flavors, a delightful fusion of savory garlic, sweet cream cheese, and a soft, pillowy bread base. Originating from the bustling bakeries of South Korea, this unique creation has become a viral sensation, tempting foodies everywhere to try their hand at making it. If you're ready to dive into the wonderful world of Korean baking and discover how to make this iconic treat, you've come to the right place.

## What is Korean Cream Cheese Garlic Bread?

At its core, Korean Cream Cheese Garlic Bread is a brioche-style bun or similar soft bread, deeply scored and then generously filled with a sweetened cream cheese mixture. But the magic doesn't stop there. The entire creation is then drenched in a rich, buttery, garlicky glaze, often infused with honey or condensed milk, before being baked to golden perfection. The result is a bread that is crispy on the outside from the garlic butter, incredibly soft and fluffy within, and bursts with a delightful contrast of savory garlic and sweet, tangy cream cheese in every bite. It’s a comforting yet sophisticated pastry that exemplifies the innovative spirit of Korean baking, offering a unique twist on two beloved classics: garlic bread and cheesecake. The distinctive star-shaped cuts allow the bread to soak up maximum flavor and provide perfect pockets for the creamy filling, making each slice a truly decadent experience.

## Ingredients You Need

To embark on your journey to create the perfect Korean Cream Cheese Garlic Bread, gather these essential ingredients. Quality makes a difference, especially for the bread and dairy components.

For the Bread:
*   6 pre-baked brioche buns, dinner rolls, or milk bread buns (about 3-4 inches in diameter) – a slightly sweet, soft bread works best.

For the Cream Cheese Filling:
*   8 oz (226g) cream cheese, softened
*   2-3 tablespoons granulated sugar (adjust to your sweetness preference)
*   1 tablespoon milk or heavy cream
*   1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract

For the Garlic Butter Glaze:
*   1/2 cup (113g) unsalted butter, melted
*   4-6 cloves garlic, minced (or 2 tablespoons pre-minced garlic)
*   2 tablespoons mayonnaise (this adds richness and helps prevent separation)
*   1 tablespoon condensed milk or honey (for sweetness and shine)
*   1 tablespoon milk or heavy cream
*   1 teaspoon dried parsley flakes (for color and subtle herb flavor)
*   Pinch of salt

## Step-by-Step Instructions

Creating this delicious Korean Cream Cheese Garlic Bread is simpler than you might think. Follow these steps for a guaranteed success:

1.  **Prepare the Buns:** Preheat your oven to 350°F (175°C). Take each bun and carefully make 6-8 deep cuts, starting from the center and radiating outwards like a star or flower, but do not cut all the way through the bottom. You want to create pockets for the filling.
2.  **Make the Cream Cheese Filling:** In a medium bowl, combine the softened cream cheese, granulated sugar, milk/cream, and vanilla extract. Mix with a spatula or electric mixer until smooth and creamy. Transfer the filling to a piping bag (with or without a star tip) for easier application. If you don't have a piping bag, a ziploc bag with a corner snipped off works, or simply use a spoon.
3.  **Fill the Buns:** Gently open up the cuts in each bun and generously pipe or spoon the cream cheese filling into each crevice. You can also pipe a dollop on top of the center for extra indulgence.
4.  **Prepare the Garlic Butter Glaze:** In another bowl, combine the melted butter, minced garlic, mayonnaise, condensed milk/honey, milk/cream, dried parsley flakes, and a pinch of salt. Whisk everything together until well combined. The mayonnaise might seem unusual, but it emulsifies the mixture beautifully and adds a lovely tang.
5.  **Bathe the Buns in Garlic Butter:** Place the filled buns on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Using a pastry brush, generously brush the garlic butter glaze over and into every part of the buns. Ensure the cuts and the top are thoroughly coated. Alternatively, you can dip the entire bun into the glaze for maximum saturation, allowing excess to drip off.
6.  **Bake:** Bake in the preheated oven for 10-15 minutes, or until the bread is golden brown and the cream cheese filling is warm and slightly gooey. Keep an eye on them to prevent burning due to the sugar in the glaze.
7.  **Serve Warm:** Remove from the oven and serve immediately.

## Pro Tips for the Best Results

Achieving bakery-quality Korean Cream Cheese Garlic Bread at home is within reach with a few expert tips:

*   **Soft Bread is Key:** The success of this recipe hinges on using a very soft, slightly sweet bread. Brioche is ideal, but good quality milk bread or even large, soft dinner rolls will work. Stale bread will be too tough.
*   **Soften Cream Cheese Properly:** Ensure your cream cheese is at room temperature before mixing. This prevents lumps and ensures a smooth, pipeable filling.
*   **Don't Skimp on Garlic Butter:** The garlic butter glaze is what gives this bread its iconic flavor and glossy finish. Be generous! Let the bread truly soak it up.
*   **Deep Cuts:** Make sure your cuts are deep enough to create substantial pockets for the cream cheese but not so deep that the bun falls apart. About 3/4 of the way through is usually perfect.
*   **Adjust Sweetness:** The sweetness of the cream cheese filling and the garlic butter glaze can be adjusted to your preference. If you like it less sweet, reduce the sugar/condensed milk.
*   **Serve Immediately:** While still delicious cooled, Korean Cream Cheese Garlic Bread is truly best enjoyed warm, straight from the oven, when the contrast of textures and temperatures is at its peak.

## Serving Suggestions

Korean Cream Cheese Garlic Bread is incredibly versatile and can be enjoyed in various ways. Its rich, satisfying flavor makes it a perfect snack on its own, perhaps with a cup of coffee or tea for a delightful breakfast or afternoon treat. It also makes an excellent appetizer for gatherings, impressing guests with its unique appearance and taste. For a lighter meal, consider pairing it with a simple green salad to balance the richness. Some enjoy it alongside a hearty bowl of soup, using it to sop up every last drop. However you choose to serve it, ensure it's warm for the ultimate experience.

## Variations and Substitutions

While the classic Korean Cream Cheese Garlic Bread is a masterpiece, feel free to experiment and make it your own:

*   **Herbs:** Instead of just parsley, try adding a pinch of dried oregano or Italian seasoning to the garlic butter for a different aromatic profile. Fresh chives or green onions can also be finely chopped and added to the garlic butter or sprinkled on top after baking for a fresh burst of flavor.
*   **Cheese:** For an extra savory kick in the cream cheese filling, mix in a tablespoon of grated Parmesan cheese. You could also sprinkle some mozzarella on top before baking for a cheesy pull.
*   **Spice:** A tiny pinch of red pepper flakes in the garlic butter can add a subtle heat that complements the sweetness.
*   **Bread Base:** While brioche is traditional, you can experiment with other soft breads like challah or even homemade milk bread. For a quicker version, high-quality frozen dinner rolls can be used.
*   **Sweetness:** Adjust the amount of sugar in the cream cheese and condensed milk/honey in the garlic butter to suit your palate. Some prefer a sweeter profile, while others like it more savory.
*   **Egg Wash:** For an even richer golden-brown color, brush the buns with an egg wash (one egg beaten with a tablespoon of water) before applying the garlic butter, then proceed with the recipe.

This beloved Korean Cream Cheese Garlic Bread is more than just a recipe; it's an experience. It’s a testament to the creativity of Korean baking, offering a perfect blend of sweet, savory, soft, and crispy. Whether you're a seasoned baker or a curious beginner, this recipe is sure to delight and impress. So, roll up your sleeves, gather your ingredients, and get ready to bake a batch of this viral sensation that will undoubtedly become a new favorite in your home.
